colombia.title: Afidro le tendió la mano a la nueva ministra de Salud, Ana María Vesga: propuso agenda conjunta para superar la crisis del sistema

mundo.title: Iran Says It Targeted U.S. Military in Kuwait With Drones
mundo.snippet: The Iranian army said it had targeted U.S. assets at a Kuwaiti air base. There were no immediate reports of any attacks from Kuwait or from the U.S. military.
